answers.core: It looks like this enhancement will significantly affect the user experience and will allow to unleash the potential of the functionality that already exists in Godot, will give the opportunity to abandon external animation editors, such as Spine, DragonBones, which allow to create complex meshes, but have issues using with Godot. So I think it's worth adding this feature to the editor.

title: Ability to automatically create a polygon in the Polygon2D UV editor
